dedupe_keys.name: mira south america multi hazard susceptibility exposure and city priority data

description: The MIRA authors publish research maps, validation outputs and city tables for multi-hazard susceptibility and socioeconomic exposure across South America. Zenodo supplies an archive under CC BY-NC 4.0. It contains terrain, hydrology, climate, land-cover, population and economic predictors; flood, drought and wildfire validation rasters; XGBoost and weighted-benchmark outputs; and GeoPackage or CSV city results. These layers can seed regional infrastructure-exposure and prioritisation simulations. No related catalogue record explicitly covers this release. Coverage is the South American regional comparison and its mapped cities, not an engineering survey of each asset. A limitation stated by the publishers is that the maps are research products, not operational warnings, forecasts or loss estimates. Weighted scores and susceptibility depend on training labels and predictor choices; city averages hide within-city variation. The companion viewer was noted but not used to validate raster values. No archive was downloaded or model score recalculated.
